quote: When people see science-fiction films, and see all this hype about AI, they might think that human AI is just about to happen , that it's being developed in labs right now and it's going to be with us soon. I don't think it's going to be with us anytime soon.
claim_summary: Says the belief that human-level AI is about to happen is a common misconception; he does not think it will arrive any time soon.
